examined_formations.title: SAAS_AND_CLOUD_SLA_CREDIT_RECOVERY
examined_formations.chinese_title: SaaS与云服务SLA违约积分自动追回
examined_formations.structural_gap: Providers commonly require customers to prove downtime, calculate eligibility and file within a deadline instead of applying credits automatically.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Customer can authorize contract ingestion, telemetry/status evidence and support-account claim submission.

examined_formations.title: SAAS_CONTRACT_INVOICE_OVERBILLING_RECOVERY
examined_formations.structural_gap: Signed order forms and negotiated caps live separately from recurring invoices, allowing seat, tier, uplift and bundled-line discrepancies.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Customer can upload contracts and invoices and authorize vendor disputes.

examined_formations.title: PARCEL_INVOICE_REFUND_RECOVERY
examined_formations.chinese_title: 快递账单差错与服务失败退款追回
examined_formations.structural_gap: Carrier contracts, shipment records and invoice surcharges must be reconciled line by line and claims filed before windows close.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Shippers can connect carrier billing accounts and authorize claim filing.

examined_formations.title: COMMERCIAL_LEASE_CAM_OVERCHARGE_RECOVERY
examined_formations.chinese_title: 商业租赁CAM运营费用超收审计追回
examined_formations.structural_gap: Lease-specific caps, exclusions, gross-up rules and pro-rata formulas must be tested against landlord CAM statements and supporting records before audit windows expire.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Tenant audit rights and tenant-owned lease/statement data can authorize an auditor or software workflow.

examined_formations.title: CPG_RETAIL_DEDUCTION_RECOVERY
examined_formations.chinese_title: 消费品零售扣款与短付追回
examined_formations.structural_gap: Retailer deductions, remittance codes, agreements, POs, PODs and portal evidence are fragmented and dispute windows expire.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Supplier controls remittance/contract evidence and can authorize retailer-portal disputes.

examined_formations.title: AMAZON_FBA_REIMBURSEMENT_RECOVERY
examined_formations.structural_gap: Some FBA reimbursement classes remain deadline-driven and require seller evidence even after Amazon expanded proactive reimbursement.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Seller can authorize account/report access and submit reimbursement claims.
